supersession-2026-08-14: Steps 1-2 are DONE, and the v3-migration design was superseded on the evidence: share tokens encode the SPEC (SPEC_VERSION wire format), never the document envelope, and planOrigin set the precedent for optional document slots with NO version bump. The site slot follows that precedent - site-less documents are byte-identical to their pre-site selves (pinned in document.spec.ts: same canonical JSON, same hash), so no migration, no codec change, no golden churn. What the old design did that this one deliberately does not: nothing - v3 existed only to carry the slot, and an optional slot carries itself. Remaining steps 3-6 (guided Site step, 'Use this plot', A1 threading + checkSpecAgainstParcel, terrain, site-proof) consume lib/builder/site.ts as shipped.

evidence.closedLate: This record shipped in commits 8ee3ce4 and fb6439c and sat at status 'ready' until Audit #9 finding 2 caught it. Recording that, because an unclosed node's rejection gates are never re-read, which is precisely how FD1's incomplete write-set survived two audits.
evidence.delivered: Optional site slot on BuilderDocument with byte-stability pinned (a site-less document is identical to its pre-site self, same canonical JSON and hash); the guided Site step hosting /design's ParcelPanel verbatim and writing only validated parcels; checkSpecAgainstParcel called for the first time since it was written, answering the fit question beside the form; the A1 SITE PLAN sheet receiving a real parcel and still printing its honest blank without one; lib/builder/terrain.ts gradeHeightFt plus per-pile lengths, with the viewport ground displaced from the same function the schedule measures.
